description: Finds which venues sell a dish or cuisine, such as pizza or biryani, by searching the menus of live venues in a city or country (never event organisers). Items filed under a category with the searched name (a Platters section for platter) come first, then dish names and descriptions; close equivalents are searched too (platter also finds basket and sharing plate) and listed in alsoSearched. Returns, for each venue with a match, the venue (whether it delivers, whether it is open now, and its distance when a position is known) and up to perVenue matching items with price and whether they have required choices; matchingItems and moreMatches say how many more exist. When a position is given, or the connected person has a default saved location, venues come back nearest first. Use list_menu_items with the venue id for the full menu and each item's options. Matches marked soldAheadOnly are sold only for a scheduled date (a pre-order with a time slot). Uses a search index, so it covers every live venue quickly. A city or countryCode narrows it and is recommended, because dish names are the same everywhere.

nearLat.description: With nearLng: venues come back nearest-first from this point

openNow.description: true: only venues open right now

perVenue.description: Matching items shown per venue; each venue says how many more matched

query.description: A dish or cuisine, e.g. pizza, biryani, burger. Every word must appear in the item's name, category or description

savedLocationId.description: A saved location of the connected person (list_saved_locations): venues come back nearest-first from it

name: search_menu
title: Search menus across venues
